$comment: Customer journeys as code (docs/product-analytics.md). Steps are event names from config/events.json, in order. `pnpm journeys:sync` turns each journey into a PostHog funnel insight plus a threshold alert (conversion below minConversion) and an Umami funnel; `pnpm journeys:report` prints the current funnel. windowDays: how long a user has to finish the journey. minConversion: overall first-to-last-step conversion in percent below which the PostHog alert fires. maxStepSeconds: target time per step, reported (median from PostHog) but not alerted on. surveys: in-app surveys (PostHog popovers, synced by the same command). type: nps (0-10) or csat (1-5). followUp: optional open question after the rating. trigger: `event` from config/events.json (not pii) and/or `url` (substring of the page URL). activeForDays: only users first seen at least that many days ago. waitDays: skip users who saw any survey in the last N days. repeat: { everyDays, times } re-asks; absent = ask once. flag: the config/flags.json entry the survey is linked to; it shows only where that flag is on.

journeys.name: activation
journeys.description: A new visitor signs up, creates an organization and a first project.

journeys.name: ai-summary-review
journeys.description: A member sees an AI summary and confirms or corrects it.

journeys.name: onboarding-tour
journeys.description: A new user who sees the product tour finishes it (docs/onboarding.md).

journeys.name: demo-booking
journeys.description: A visitor or user opens a booking link and books a call in the Cal.com embed (docs/crm.md). Bookings made on the Cal.com page after the link opened there are counted in Cal.com, not here.

journeys.name: site-to-signup
journeys.description: A marketing-site visitor clicks a call to action and creates an account in the app. Needs the site and the app on one PostHog/Umami project (docs/marketing.md).

surveys.question: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend or colleague?
surveys.followUp: What is the main reason for your score?

surveys.question: How satisfied are you with creating a project?
